title: apiType=52 TOTAL2–TOTAL14 field mapping investigation

decision.reason: Official Korean labels for openData TOTAL* columns are not published in any reachable SchoolInfo client header source. School detail rendering and Excel download endpoints that would bind labels to TOTAL* are currently unavailable (서비스 일시 중단). Observational matches and guideline leaf order are recorded as evidence only — not confirmed TOTAL-field bindings.

sourcesChecked.result: EMPTY — column definitions commented out (same state in Wayback 2022-01-31 copy)
No sheet for 졸업생의 진로 현황 (52); matches open-data UI item list which also omits 52
Item 52 intentionally absent from loadOpenData() titles; API still returns data
HTTP 200 but body is 서비스 일시 중단 안내 — cannot read Excel/HTML headers
Official category DEFINITIONS confirmed (일반고/특성화고/특수목적고 subtypes/자율고/기타/취업자/대안/무직미상) — not TOTAL* index binding

sourcesChecked.source: 2022 초·중등학교 정보공시 입력 지침서 13-다 중학교 장표
sourcesChecked.result: Official leaf display order + circled numbers ①–⑯ including 계 subtotals; leaf set size=12 matches TOTAL3–TOTAL14 count
Raw JSON available (3524 middle schools); 잠실중학교 S010000888 matches user-provided totals exactly
Secondary journalism: Excel columns listed as 일반고→특성화고→과학고→외국어고·국제고→예고·체고→마이스터고→자율형사립고→자율형공립고→기타; not a KERIS TOTAL* schema

officialTaxonomyMiddleSchool.graduatesEquation: 졸업자 = 진학자 + 취업자 + 대안교육기관진학(학력미인정) + 무직자 및 미상

advancers.일반고: 특정분야가 아닌 다양한 분야에 걸쳐 일반적인 교육을 실시하는 고등학교
advancers.특성화고: 직업교육 또는 체험위주 대안교육을 전문적으로 실시하는 고등학교
advancers.특수목적고: 과학고, 외국어고, 국제고, 예술고, 체육고, 마이스터고로 분류
advancers.기타: 외국인학교, 특수학교, 각종학교, 영재학교, 국외교육기관(학력인정) 등 진학자

officialTaxonomyMiddleSchool.note: 예고·체고 is ONE combined leaf in the guideline table (예술고+체육고 not separate TOTAL leaves). 영재학교 is under 기타, not a separate TOTAL leaf.

TOTAL2.evidence: Raw TOTAL2=337 equals user screen 졸업자 337 and equals sum(TOTAL3..TOTAL14). Official hangmok text defines 졸업자. No client header maps column TOTAL2→졸업자.

TOTAL3.evidence: Numeric match with user-reported screen 일반 223 (66.2%). Aligns with guideline leaf #1. No official TOTAL3 header definition found.

TOTAL4.evidence: Numeric match with user-reported screen 특성화고 6 (1.8%). Aligns with guideline leaf #2. No official TOTAL4 header definition found.

TOTAL5.evidence: No screen label provided by user for this non-zero field. Guideline leaf order would place 과학고 here — NOT confirmed; not filled.

TOTAL6.evidence: Numeric match with user-reported screen 외고·국제고 9 (2.7%). Aligns with guideline leaf #4. No official TOTAL6 header definition found.

TOTAL7.evidence: No screen label. Guideline leaf order would place 예고·체고 here — NOT confirmed; not filled.

TOTAL8.evidence: No screen label. Guideline leaf order would place 마이스터고 here — NOT confirmed; not filled.

TOTAL9.evidence: Numeric match with user-reported screen label 자사고 86 (25.5%). Official hangmok text uses 자율형 사립고 (under 자율고). Product must NOT widen label to 자사고 until official TOTAL9 binding is confirmed. TOTAL9 is separate from TOTAL10.

TOTAL10.evidence: Zero at 잠실중. Guideline leaf order would place 자율형공립고 here — NOT confirmed; not filled. Nationwide raw shows some schools with TOTAL10>0 (e.g. 휘경여자중학교=2).

TOTAL11.evidence: Numeric match with user-reported screen 기타 5 (1.5%). Official 기타 includes 영재학교. No official TOTAL11 header definition found.

TOTAL12.evidence: Zero at 잠실중. Guideline non-advancer order would place 취업자 here — NOT confirmed; not filled.

TOTAL13.evidence: Zero at 잠실중 (잠신중 TOTAL13=1). Guideline would place 대안교육기관진학(학력미인정) here — NOT confirmed; not filled.

TOTAL14.evidence: Zero at 잠실중 (송파중 TOTAL14=2). Guideline would place 무직자 및 미상 here — NOT confirmed; not filled.

specialPurpose.과학고: UNCONFIRMED field — likely TOTAL5 by guideline order only; not bound
specialPurpose.외고·국제고: UNCONFIRMED field — observational TOTAL6 match; not officially bound
specialPurpose.예술고: Not a separate openData leaf in 13-다 guideline; combined as 예고·체고
specialPurpose.체육고: Not a separate openData leaf in 13-다 guideline; combined as 예고·체고
specialPurpose.마이스터고: UNCONFIRMED field — likely TOTAL8 by guideline order only; not bound
specialPurpose.기타특목: No separate TOTAL leaf; 특수목적고 subtypes are 과학고/외고·국제고/예고·체고/마이스터고 only
specialPurpose.자율형사립고: UNCONFIRMED field — observational TOTAL9 vs screen 자사고; official term is 자율형사립고
specialPurpose.자율형공립고: UNCONFIRMED field — likely TOTAL10 by guideline order only; separate from TOTAL9
specialPurpose.영재학교: Officially under 기타 (not a separate TOTAL field)

잠실중학교.screenCrossCheck: User screen labels for non-zero displayed categories match TOTAL3/4/6/9/11 values; TOTAL5/7/8 non-zero but not listed in user screen excerpt
